Plugin.Name: unraid-icons
Plugin.Overview: A shared icon library for Unraid VMs and Docker containers. Browse application logos from selfh.st and Dashboard Icons, choose symbols from Iconify, or import a custom image URL. Download icons once and select them from the VM and Docker editors. Optional integrations support Compose Manager Plus and FolderView3. Manage downloaded icons under Settings → Icons. Downloaded icons and preferences are retained across updates, reboots, and plugin removal.
